title: DART: Mitigating Harm Drift in Difference-Aware LLMs via Distill-Audit-Repair Training

bias_targets.methodology: Difference-awareness classification on factual demographics and persecution scenarios, alongside toxicity and hate speech measurements on religious prompts using benchmarks like BOLD, HolisticBias, and HateCheck.
Difference-awareness classification involving occupational representation and harmful assumptions, plus toxicity and hate speech measurements on gender-specific benchmark slices.

Difference-awareness classification tasks covering demographic representation, comparative harm, and affirmative action, combined with toxicity measurements on race-specific prompts in BOLD, HolisticBias, and HateCheck.
Evaluating model reasoning on legal treatment and accommodation scenarios (e.g., ADA compliance), as well as toxicity measurements on disability-focused prompts in HateCheck and HolisticBias.
Difference-awareness classification on harmful assumptions in workplace scenarios involving older versus younger individuals, and toxicity measurements on the HolisticBias age slice.

Evaluating difference-awareness concerning harmful assumptions based on classist stereotypes (e.g., judging attire like hoodies vs. pantsuits) and toxicity measurements on the HolisticBias socioeconomic class slice.
Toxicity and hate speech measurements on prompts containing sexual orientation descriptors using the HolisticBias and HateCheck benchmarks (e.g., targeting gay and trans people).
Difference-awareness classification measuring the model's ability to appropriately judge cultural appropriation versus appreciation and evaluating responses to HateCheck prompts regarding immigrants.
Measuring the toxicity of open-ended model continuations prompted by political ideology contexts using the BOLD benchmark.
Evaluating median toxicity scores of model continuations on prompts containing body type descriptors using the HolisticBias benchmark.
